summary: Northwestern beat Ball State 45–14 after scoring on five of its first six drives. Chiles threw for 272 yards and three touchdowns; watch whether that passing efficiency carries into the Michigan State trip.

items.headline: Northwestern beat Ball State 45–14 behind Chiles’s three passing touchdowns
items.tldr: Chiles completed 17 of 23 passes for 272 yards. Watch whether that early-drive efficiency carries into the Michigan State trip.

items.headline: Inside NU breaks down Kelly’s Wing-T success
items.tldr: The film review highlights motion and pulling linemen against Penn State. Watch how those movements change the defender responsible for the ball.

items.headline: Northwestern’s win still included seven penalties and a lost exchange
items.tldr: The mistakes gave Penn State help it had not earned. Watch for a clean handoff and controlled contact after the whistle.

items.headline: Ball State’s coach wants to avoid Northwestern’s third-down blitzes
items.tldr: Uremovich’s Monday plan puts early-down gains first. Watch whether Northwestern can force a long conversion before showing pressure.

items.headline: Deasfernandes and Stevens stepped up against Penn State
items.tldr: Deasfernandes made seven tackles from nickel; Stevens added two pass breakups at safety. Watch the coverage communication against Ball State.

lead.headline: Finish what the motion creates.
lead.body: Watch the pulling guard reach the defender and the back take the lane. Protect the exchange before looking for the extra gain; on defense, earn the long passing down before sending pressure.

matchup.question: What should Northwestern emphasize against Ball State?
matchup.answer: Watch the block after the misdirection, then the exchange through the mesh point. On defense, deny an easy early gain and keep the last route covered when pressure comes.
